privileged_info_for_vlm: The target collection must be exactly 'Dissertation Notes'. Note 1 must contain 'Research Questions' and keywords: transformer, attention, scalability. Note 2 must contain 'Key Findings' and keywords: pre-training, fine-tuning, benchmark. For keywords 'pre-training' and 'fine-tuning', versions without hyphens (pretraining/finetuning) are acceptable. Both notes must exceed 100 characters in length.
